refund-policy.title: Refunds and Cancellation
refund-policy.intro: Refund windows, cancellation steps and billing support for our software products.
sections: Which policy applies?

This company website introduces our products and does not take payments. Each product has its own purchase terms. The summaries below reflect the published product policies reviewed on October 8, 2026. The terms presented with your order, the product policy and applicable consumer law govern your purchase.

If a summary and your order terms differ, contact us before buying or renewing so we can clarify the terms that apply. No summary on this page removes a right you have under applicable law.
Blaze Humanizer: 14-day refund window

Blaze Humanizer offers a full refund when requested within 14 days of purchase. Its policy covers plans and add-ons, with exceptions for abuse, fraud or violations of its terms. After that window, its published policy treats purchases as non-refundable, subject to applicable legal rights.

Request a refund from info@blazehumanizer.com using the purchase email and order or upgrade-code reference. Approved refunds return to the original payment method. Bank or processor processing may take several business days. Refunded codes and associated access are deactivated.

Read the Blaze Humanizer Refund Policy.
VividWriter: 7-day refund window

VividWriter offers a refund requested within 7 days of purchase. For subscriptions, this promise applies to the first payment. Later renewal refunds are assessed under its product policy. Refunds may be declined for abuse of the refund window or license misuse.

Use the contact details in the VividWriter Refund Policy and include the purchase email or order number. Approved refunds return through the payment provider to the original payment method. The product policy explains processing times and what happens to your license and locally stored books.

Charges billed directly by your AI provider are separate from the software purchase and must be addressed with that provider.
Vidket: free public beta

Vidket is currently free during its public beta, so there is no beta subscription payment to refund. Its terms state that paid plans require you to choose a plan before charges apply. Review the Vidket Terms of Service and current pricing before selecting a future paid plan.
How to cancel or stop renewing

• VividWriter: cancel a subscription from your product account. Its published policy says cancellation stops the next renewal and preserves access for the period already paid for. Cancellation and a refund request are separate actions.
  • Blaze Humanizer: the current purchase flow uses codes for fixed-term plans and invites customers to renew with a new code. To stop renewing that arrangement, do not purchase a renewal code. For an order with different billing terms, follow the cancellation instructions on its receipt or contact product support.
  • Vidket: you may stop using the free beta. Its account settings also offer account deletion, which deletes stored content and is not a billing cancellation step. Save anything you need before deleting an account.

If you cannot access a cancellation option, contact the product support team or email us with your order details before the next billing date. Do not assume that uninstalling software or sending a general inquiry cancels a subscription. Retain the cancellation confirmation.
Billing questions and refund requests

Email obutebasil@gmail.com if you need help identifying the correct product or support channel. Include the product name, purchase email, charge date and order reference where available. Do not send a complete payment card number, security code or password.

For a separately negotiated service or developer agreement, the signed agreement sets out any cancellation and refund provisions. Mandatory consumer rights still apply. Contacting us does not require you to give up any statutory complaint or dispute rights.
Digital returns

We sell digital software and services, so there are no physical goods to return or return-shipping costs. Any change to a license or access after a refund follows the applicable product policy. For access problems, see our Digital Delivery Policy.

delivery-policy.title: Digital Delivery Policy
delivery-policy.intro: How to access our software and get help with a download, license or product account.
sections: Digital products only

Our products are software and online services. There are no physical shipments, delivery addresses, shipping charges or return-shipping arrangements for these products.

This company website links to the product websites. Ordering, account creation and any license activation happen through the relevant product or its checkout provider.
How access is provided

• Vidket: create and use an online account through Vidket. It is currently free during beta.
  • Blaze Humanizer: purchase a plan code through the product's store and redeem it in the application, following the order instructions.
  • VividWriter: use the download and license instructions provided for your order to install and activate the desktop software on a supported Windows or macOS device.
Delivery timing and requirements

The relevant product page, checkout or order confirmation describes its availability and delivery or activation steps. This company website does not offer a separate delivery-time guarantee. Before paying, confirm that you understand how and when access will be provided. Contact us if that information is unclear.

Check the product's supported devices, internet requirements, account or license limits, and any third-party services needed for the features you want. Where a product requires your own AI provider key, that provider's setup and usage charges are separate from software delivery.
Missing or unusable access

If an order confirmation, license code or download instruction is missing, check the purchase email address and spam folder, then contact the product support team. If you received instructions but cannot use them, include the error message and device details without sharing passwords or secret keys.

You can also email obutebasil@gmail.com with the product name, purchase email and order reference. We can help locate the appropriate support channel. Do not pay again just to resolve an access issue.
Location and availability

We welcome customers and partners worldwide. Availability of a particular product, payment method or third-party service may depend on your country and applicable legal restrictions. Worldwide business inquiries do not guarantee that every product or checkout method is available in every location. Check the relevant product and checkout before ordering.
Refunds and contact

An access problem does not remove any refund or other remedy available under the product terms or applicable law. Read our Refunds and Cancellation page, or use the Contact and Support page for assistance.
